extraction: Loop design check Greenkeeper example: loop that updates dependencies. Goal: 'All deps updated, tests pass'. Decidable: yes. Loop type: iterative (per dep). Skeleton: Check outdated → Update one → Test → Commit → Next. Failure modes: Token burn (many deps) — batch updates. Goodhart (tests pass but broken) — integration tests. Wrong answer (incompatible) — version constraints. Maps to our Engine: not directly applicable, but pattern shows how to design safe iterative loops with decidable goals.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: loop-design-check methodology validates our Engine build loop design
